# Function-local declarations exercise the installed default validator.
# Their scope excludes generated serialization methods and constructors.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Accepted controls cover numeric boundaries, composite keys and blank fields.
logos build -o $WORK/control.exe ./control

# The default is checked in its declaration's file or local scope.
logos build -o $WORK/imported.exe ./imported
logos build -o $WORK/local.exe ./local

# Every invalid declaration must fail without constructing its type.
! logos build -o $WORK/overflow-low.exe ./overflow_low
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*overflows'
! logos build -o $WORK/overflow-high.exe ./overflow_high
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*overflows'
! logos build -o $WORK/scalar.exe ./scalar
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/composite.exe ./composite
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/map-key.exe ./map_key
stderr 'bad.lgo:5:[0-9]+:.*\[correctness::default_not_constant\]'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank.exe ./blank
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank-defaults.exe ./blank_defaults
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank-group.exe ./blank_group
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'

# Anchor: Tony Hoare. The installed compiler stores types in syntax nodes,
# so declaration validation must not depend on a populated Info.Types map.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Imported and local constants retain declaration scope; both uint8 bounds
# are accepted. Native, ejected, and upstream executions agree.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^defaults checked: 1000000000 17 0 255$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ../../bad

# None of these types is instantiated. Opaque disables generated serializers,
# so rejection must come from declaration validation rather than generated Go.
cp ../cases/below.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'
! logos eject -o $WORK/below-out
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'

cp ../cases/above.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'
! logos eject -o $WORK/above-out
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'

cp ../cases/scalar.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/scalar-out
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'

cp ../cases/composite.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/composite-out
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'

cp ../cases/mapkey.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr '\[correctness::default_not_constant\] non-constant default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/mapkey-out
stderr '\[correctness::default_not_constant\] non-constant default for field Value'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/defaultvalidation

go 1.27
-- control/main.lgo --
package main

func unused() {
	type Bounds struct {
		Zero      uint8 = 0
		One       uint8 = 1
		BeforeMax uint8 = 254
		Max       uint8 = 255
	}
	type Composites struct {
		Numbers []int = []int{1, 2}
		Fields struct { N int } = struct { N int }{N: 1}
		Table map[int]string = map[int]string{1: "ok"}
	}
	type BlankAfter struct { _ int; _ string = "ok" }
	type BlankDefaults struct { _ int = 1; _ string = "ok" }
	type BlankGroup struct { _ int; _, Value string = "ok" }
	type BlankTail struct { _ int; Value, _ string = "ok" }
}

func main() {}
-- imported/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func unused() { type Unused struct { Delay time.Duration = time.Second } }

func main() {}
-- local/main.lgo --
package main

func unused() {
	const local = 17
	type Unused struct { Value int = local }
}

func main() {}
-- overflow_low/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value uint8 = -1 } }

func main() {}
-- overflow_high/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value uint8 = 256 } }

func main() {}
-- scalar/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- composite/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value []int = []string{"bad"} } }

func main() {}
-- map_key/bad.lgo --
package main

var calls int
func key() int { calls++; return calls }
func unused() { type Unused struct { Value map[int]int = map[int]int{key(): 1} } }

func main() {}
-- blank/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string; _ int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- blank_defaults/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string = "first"; _ int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- blank_group/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string; _, Value int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/defaultvalidation

go 1.27

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

type Imported struct { Delay time.Duration = time.Second }
type Bounds struct {
	Min uint8 = 0
	Max uint8 = 255
}

func main() {
	const amount = 17
	type Local struct { Value int = amount }
	a := Imported{}
	b := Local{}
	c := Bounds{}
	if a.Delay != time.Second || b.Value != 17 || c.Min != 0 || c.Max != 255 {
		panic("wrong declaration default")
	}
	fmt.Printf("defaults checked: %d %d %d %d\n", a.Delay, b.Value, c.Min, c.Max)
}

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/unuseddefault

go 1.27

-- cases/below.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value uint8 = -1
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/above.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value uint8 = 256
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/scalar.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value int = "bad"
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/composite.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value []int = []string{"bad"}
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/mapkey.lgo --
package bad

var Calls int

func key() int {
	Calls++
	return 1
}

type Unused struct {
	Value map[int]int = map[int]int{key(): 1}
	Opaque map[int]int
}
